text: Released our [solution and technical report](https://github.com/guthsplan/behavior1k-2026-solution) for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge (team VGI-SKT).
Attended the Agentic AI Summit 2026 at UC Berkeley as an AgentX–AgentBeats winner.
**1st place (tie)** in Phase 2 of [AgentX–AgentBeats](https://rdi.berkeley.edu/agentx-agentbeats) with VGI-Player, our Minecraft purple agent.
**1st place** in Phase 1 of [AgentX–AgentBeats](https://rdi.berkeley.edu/agentx-agentbeats) with our agentified Minecraft (MCU) benchmark.
Joined the Yonsei Multimedia AI Lab as a research intern (CAD-free 6-DoF pose tracking).
Joined the SNU Visual & Geometric Intelligence Lab as a research intern.
